meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 2 — Industrial production, FDI (by partner), rice/agriculture, and regional economic structure (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Red River Delta, industrial provinces). Continues USA trade densification from Batch 1.

candidates.title: Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / National Statistics Office
candidates.description: Monthly and cumulative Index of Industrial Production covering manufacturing, mining, electricity and water. Manufacturing dominates growth; electronics and related processing are major drivers.

candidates.title: Foreign Direct Investment statistics (registered and disbursed)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Planning and Investment / GSO related
candidates.description: Official FDI attraction figures (new projects, additional capital, capital contributions). Processing and manufacturing typically absorb the large majority of inflows. Singapore, Korea, China, Japan and others lead recent rankings; US FDI stock and flows remain strategically important.
candidates.notes: High-centrality investment node. Manufacturing absorbs ~2/3 of recent FDI.

candidates.title: FDI by major partner country / territory
candidates.description: Breakdown of FDI inflows by source. Singapore, South Korea, China, Japan, Hong Kong and others dominate recent flows; US FDI is smaller in annual ranking but significant in stock, technology and strategic sectors.
candidates.notes: Partner-side densification of the FDI cluster. Complements the large USA export relationship.

candidates.title: Rice production statistics
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / Ministry of Agriculture related
candidates.description: Official volume and area statistics for rice (paddy). Vietnam remains one of the world’s top rice exporters; the Mekong Delta is the primary production basin.

candidates.title: Agriculture, forestry and fishery production statistics
candidates.description: Broader primary-sector output covering crops, livestock, forestry and fisheries/aquaculture. Complements the rice-focused series.

candidates.title: Hanoi Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
candidates.description: Official GRDP for the capital city. Major services, administration and industrial contributor to national growth.
candidates.notes: Primary northern urban-core regional output node.

candidates.title: Ho Chi Minh City Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Ho Chi Minh City — Vietnam’s largest urban economy and southern commercial/industrial hub. Together with Hanoi forms the dual-core national economic structure.
candidates.notes: Primary southern urban-core regional output node.

candidates.title: Red River Delta regional economic profile
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO GRDP and industrial series
candidates.description: System-level view of the Red River Delta — the northern industrial and growth engine that includes Hanoi, Hai Phong, Bac Ninh and other high-performing provinces. Frequently the largest contributor to national growth.

candidates.title: Key industrial provinces (Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Dong Nai, etc.)
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO GRDP and IIP series
candidates.description: High-growth industrial provinces that drive electronics, manufacturing and port-related activity. Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Dong Nai and similar localities often post double-digit GRDP growth and large contributions to national industry.
referenced_by: Red River Delta and Southeast regional nodes
candidates.notes: Provincial industrial densification that links FDI, electronics and regional growth.

candidates.title: Vietnam industry–FDI–agriculture–regional densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO, MPI and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Index of Industrial Production, FDI statistics and partner breakdown, rice and broader agriculture production, Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City GRDP, Red River Delta profile and key industrial provinces into a coherent industry–investment–spatial layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
BOP, USA trade and national accounts from Batch 1
